_readme: Deck registry for Decks (packages/decks/scripts/deck.mjs), read from the current directory. _config: decksDir is where `decks new` scaffolds; outDir and base apply to `build` and may contain {name}; a deck entry may override either. Deck entries: alias -> { entry: slides.md path, name: slug for outDir/base, animated: true when the deck uses OpenChart/scripted demos (switches export to --with-clicks --wait 1500, dropping the TOC step that errors on HTML-only slides), skipAll: true to exclude from build --all }
